signals.entity: Slovenská pošta, a.s. (Slovak Post)
signals.signal: OPEN + EXTENDED. signals.likelihood: Award likely Q4 2026 given the 08/09 close
signals.followup: Register on Slovak Post's EVO/JOSEPHINE profile before 08/09/2026 10:00; if not bidding, track the award notice for the incumbent name.

signals.followup: Profile protectus s. r. o. (ownership, fleet, whether it services bank ATMs as well as post offices) as a partner-or-competitor for Slovak cash automation.

signals.entity: KOVAL SYSTEMS, a. s. (winner) / Slovenská pošta, a.s. (buyer)

A single-bid, estimate-matching award shows Slovak Post has no competitive field-service market for self-service terminals — exactly the gap Printec's 500+ engineer / 100+ service-point network is built to fill. Renewal falls due around May 2028.
signals.likelihood: Re-tender ~Q1 2028; interim lot expansions possible
signals.followup: Approach Slovak Post now with the Pošta Slovenije locker-maintenance reference; ask to be added to the market-consultation list for the 2028 re-tender.

signals.entity: HICO, s.r.o. (winner) / Národná banka Slovenska (buyer)
signals.signal: AWARD (winner: HICO, s.r.o.) AND A MAJOR FORWARD PROGRAMME. 'Stavebnotechnický dozor – trvalé záložné pracovisko NBS Kremnica' — construction/technical supervision for the preparation and construction of NBS's PERMANENT BACKUP SITE at Kremnica. Winning value EUR 298,198.80 against an estimate of EUR 375,000 excl. VAT; contract signed 15/07/2026 (nbs.sk/zmluvy/25903); CPV 'Stavebný dozor'. Result notice 10863-VSS, Vestník 153/2026, published 30/07/2026. ÚVO tender ID 554393. A central-bank backup site normally needs vaults, banknote-processing capacity, physical security and access control, and a resilient IT room — i.e. Printec's physical ATM/vault security, cash automation (Glory/Sesami/Consillion counting and sorting) and HSM/key-management lines. Appointing the supervisor now dates the main works procurement to roughly 2027.

RELATED AND STILL UNAWARDED: 'Razba a dodávky obehových euromincí, pamätných euromincí a euromincí určených do ročníkových súborov v rokoch 2026–2030' (circulation, commemorative and annual-set euro coins), notice 7997-MST, Vestník 113/2026, 09/06/2026, closed 06/07/2026, ÚVO tender ID 557038 — no result notice as at 27/08/2026.
signals.implies: Not a Printec sale — minting is a state monopoly — but it sizes the Slovak cash cycle NBS is still investing in and confirms cash is not being wound down. The coin volumes NBS is contracting for through 2030 support the case for coin counting/sorting and recycler capacity at Slovak banks and at the Kremnica backup site.

signals.entity: ÚVO / Slovak public-procurement market as a whole
signals.signal: STRUCTURAL NEGATIVE FINDING, tested this run. CPV 30123200 'Automated teller machines' returns ZERO notices in the entire ÚVO Vestník archive (465,236 notices). CPV 30132200 'banknote counting machines' returns only 4 notices ever, the most recent being NBS 'Nákup zariadení na spracovanie bankoviek vrátane záručného a pozáručného servisu' awarded in 2019 to Giesecke+Devrient (notice 13084-VST, 14/05/2019) — G+D is therefore NBS's banknote-processing incumbent. CPV 30123600 'coin-handling machines' returns 2 notices ever, both the NBS automatic coin processing-and-packaging line procured 2020-2021. Supplier searches (ndodavatel) for NCR, Verifone, Ingenico, Payten, Printec, Gemalto, Worldline and Nuvei all return zero Slovak notices; Diebold and Wincor appear only as generic IT hardware resellers to hospitals and universities.
signals.source_name: ÚVO Vestník search by CPV and by supplier (kcpv / ndodavatel parameters)
signals.implies: Slovak ATM, recycler and POS demand is entirely private-sector: all Slovak retail banks (SLSP/Erste, VÚB/Intesa, Tatra banka/RBI, ČSOB, Poštová banka, 365.bank, Prima banka) are private and outside the procurement law, so the ÚVO portal will never show their equipment tenders. The only public-sector cash-equipment buyer in Slovakia is NBS itself, roughly once every five years, and its banknote-processing incumbent is Giesecke+Devrient. Printec's Slovak route to market is therefore direct commercial-bank selling plus the NBS cash-centre and Kremnica backup-site cycle — not tender monitoring.
signals.likelihood: Structural; unchanged over the 12-year archive
signals.followup: Reallocate Slovak coverage effort from ÚVO tender-watching to direct bank engagement; keep only NBS, Slovenská pošta, SZRB, Eximbanka and Štátna pokladnica on the ÚVO watchlist.

signals.entity: Slovak merchants / acquirers (Act 384/2025 cashless-acceptance mandate)
signals.signal: [STANDING — dated 2025/2026, re-verified this run] Act No. 384/2025 Z. z. on the recording of sales (o evidencii tržieb), § 15 cashless payments and § 17 sanctions, obliges merchants to let customers pay cashlessly on purchases above EUR 1. The obligation was POSTPONED from the originally legislated 01/03/2026 to 01/05/2026, and the law explicitly permits alternatives to a card terminal — notably QR-code payment initiated from a mobile banking app — so it does not compel a POS terminal per merchant. The baseline's terminal-count movement (70,943 to 77,711 POS terminals between 31/12/2025 and 31/05/2026, +9.5%) is consistent with, but not attributable solely to, the mandate. Nothing in the ÚVO Vestník relates to this mandate: it drives private merchant and acquirer purchasing, not public procurement.
signals.source_name: Podnikajte.sk / danovy-poradca.sk explainers of Act 384/2025 Z. z. (secondary; primary text is Zbierka zákonov 384/2025)
signals.implies: The strongest Slovak demand driver for Printec's POS/softPOS and terminal-management lines, but it is realised entirely through acquirers and merchants, invisible on ÚVO. The QR-payment carve-out caps the terminal upside: the smallest merchants can comply without hardware, which favours softPOS (a payment terminal running on the merchant's own phone) over classic Verifone/Castles boxes at the long tail.
signals.likelihood: In force since 01/05/2026; enforcement ramp through 2026-2027
signals.followup: Verify the terminal count from the NBS payment-statistics release (nbs.sk) rather than press, and pitch softPOS + TMS to Slovak acquirers against the QR-alternative carve-out.

coverage_notes: ACCESS ROUTE SOLVED AND WORTH KEEPING: uvo.gov.sk has no public REST/open-data API (/openapi/ and /OpenData/ 302 to error404) and https://eforms.uvo.gov.sk sits behind a Keycloak login, BUT the Vestnik notice search at https://www.uvo.gov.sk/vestnik-a-registre/vestnik/oznamenia IS fully server-rendered and accepts flat query-string parameters over a 465,236-notice archive: text, nzakazky (tender name), nobstaravatel (buyer), ndodavatel (SUPPLIER - finds winners), kcpv (CPV), dzOd/dzDo (date from/to, DD.MM.YYYY), cisloOznamenia, doznamenia, year. Result rows carry the canonical detail URL in the <tr onclick> attribute (/vestnik-a-registre/vestnik/oznamenie/detail/<id>), and each detail page embeds the FULL eForms notice (values, deadlines, winners, contract dates, crz.gov.sk contract links) as inline HTML - no PDF or XML needed. Caveat: nzakazky/text match on WORD-INITIAL stems only (bankomat matched nothing; mincí matched nothing while minc as a word start does), so CPV and buyer searches are more reliable than keyword ones. The separate profile-level low-value search at /vyhladavanie/vyhladavanie-zakaziek uses different flat params (nazovZakazky, obstarNazov, obstarIco, cpv) and is also server-rendered. ANGLES RUN: (1) buyer sweeps for NARODNA BANKA SLOVENSKA (43 notices in 2026), Slovenska posta (24), SZRB (11), EXIMBANKA SR, Statna pokladnica, Mincovna Kremnica, Financne riaditelstvo SR; (2) CPV sweeps across 30123200/30123400/30123600/30123610/30123620/30123630/30132000/30132200/30144200/35121700/42961000/45312200/48814000/66110000/66172000/79710000/79713000/98341140; (3) Slovak word-stem keyword sweeps (bankomat, bankov, minc, peniaz, penaz, trezor, cenin, platob, hotovos, prepra, strazn, ochran, kamerov, identit, podpis, kiosk, samoobsluzn, terminal, akcept, Prijimanie, Core, CORBS, okamzit); (4) SUPPLIER sweeps (ndodavatel) for Diebold, NCR, Glory, Giesecke, Verifone, Payten, Wincor, Thales, Gemalto, Ingenico, Global Payments, Printec, Monet, Cominfo, Nuvei, Worldline, SIX Payment; (5) cross-check of all 30 Slovak notices in intel-cache/ted_notices.json against ÚVO primaries; (6) open-web search on Act 384/2025. PRODUCT CATEGORIES WITH NOTHING THIS RUN, stated explicitly: (1) ATM & cash automation/recycling - NOTHING, CPV 30123200 has zero notices in the whole archive; (2) self-service kiosks & branch transformation - nothing bank-side, only the Slovak Post BalikoBOX locker maintenance award; (3) POS/acquiring/softPOS - NOTHING new on ÚVO, only the standing Global Payments State Treasury contract; (8) physical ATM security - NOTHING; (9) HSM/payShield/key management - NOTHING (unlike the MNB Hungary key-storage tender in the baseline, NBS published no HSM notice); (10) card issuing & personalisation - NOTHING beyond coin minting, and the last document-personalisation award (Giesecke+Devrient, Ministry of Interior 'Cistopisy dokladov') dates to 2019; (6) fraud & transaction monitoring - NOTHING as a discrete tender. Categories that DID show: (4) payments modernization (State Treasury TIPS/CGI, NBS integration platform), (5) digital identity/e-signature only indirectly (Eximbanka records system), (7) compliance & operational resilience (SZRB SOC, SZRB regulatory reporting, NBS DDoS, NBS supervisory systems), (11) managed services/field maintenance (Slovak Post security systems, BalikoBOX service, CIT), (12) core & digital channels (SZRB core banking awarded to Asseco; NBS CORBS still unlet). BASELINE ITEMS STATUSED: NBS TED 505733-2026 corporate LAN = EXTENDED to 31/08/2026 (re-published as TED 581385-2026); Slovenska posta security-systems higher-level support = EXTENDED from 14/08/2026 to 08/09/2026; Slovenska posta ZAPAD guarding/CIT = closed 06/07/2026, award NOT yet published; SZRB SOC monitoring = was EXTENDED to 07/07/2026 (baseline's 30/06/2026 was superseded), award not yet published; Act 384/2025 = confirmed in force 01/05/2026 after postponement from 01/03/2026. NOT RE-DERIVED: baseline items belonging to other countries' portals.
access_issues: 1) https://eforms.uvo.gov.sk/ (and /api/notices, /notices, /vestnik) 302 to a Keycloak login at iam.uvo.gov.sk - LOGIN WALL, not worked around, logged here as instructed. 2) https://opendata.uvo.gov.sk/ failed to resolve (curl exit, HTTP 000). 3) /vyhladavanie/vyhladavanie-zakaziek/detail and several guessed paths 302 to /errors/error404.html, confirming the baseline note that /openapi/ and /OpenData/ are dead. 4) https://josephine.proebiz.com/sk/tender/search returns 404 - the JOSEPHINE e-procurement platform used by NBS and Slovenska posta has no public search route at that path; bid documents there require registration. 5) All working fetches used a desktop Chrome User-Agent; the ÚVO Vestnik search and notice-detail pages returned 200 and full server-rendered HTML with that UA, so no fallback to cached snippets or press was needed for any ÚVO row. 6) The result-row pageNo parameter did not paginate on GET (page 2 returned page 1), so listings over 20 rows were split by narrowing dzOd/dzDo instead - noted so a future run does not mistake this for missing data.
operator_requests: 1) eforms.uvo.gov.sk is behind a Keycloak SSO login. Everything needed for THIS run was obtainable from the public Vestnik, so this is not blocking, but an operator account there would give structured eForms XML rather than scraped HTML. 2) Bid documentation (sutazne podklady) for the two live opportunities - EXIMBANKA SR records-management system (ÚVO tender ID 563166, deadline 15/09/2026) and Slovenska posta security-systems support (ID 559931, deadline 08/09/2026) - sits on the buyers' JOSEPHINE/EVO profiles behind free registration; an operator should register and pull the technical annexes if Printec wants to bid. 3) No CAPTCHA was encountered and none was attempted.
